description: Join us for Jam For Josh Trivia on Saturday, September 26 at the Ava Community Center. Doors open at 1:00 PM, trivia starts at 2:00 PM. Tickets are $20 per person (teams up to 6). Enjoy 6 trivia rounds, 1st place prizes, a silent auction, 50/50 drawing, and concessions.
